facts.fact: MP Ahmed Badawi, chair of the House ICT committee, said an integrated AI bill is being prepared with the ministry, including mechanisms for crimes committed using AI; it is not yet published.

MP Ahmed Badawi, chair of the House ICT committee, said the ICT ministry is now preparing an integrated AI bill whose outline was agreed in community dialogue sessions, to go to the House once the government finishes it.
MP Ahmed Badawi said the House ICT committee contributed to preparing an electronic transactions bill.
